method: Automated inventory read every source, evidence, pathway, profile and review record in the exact manifest candidate for this ISO.

Automated screening compared source references, locators, geography fields, evidence class, direction, status, horizon and scenario; it checked pathway support IDs, link-evidence sets, geography fields, alternatives and uncertainty for follow-up.

Raw extraction access rows are recorded only as inherited access observations. This generated screen does not treat snippets, HTTP success, prior access, or metadata as claim verification and does not replace semantic source review.

verification_summary.limitation: Selected source access and manually adjudicated record-level passages are listed separately. Verification applies only to individually listed claims; all remaining evidence/pathways and the country bank as a whole remain unresolved-limited.

source_refs.locator: Agriculture and socioeconomic vulnerability, printed pp. 9-10 (PDF pp. 8-9).

evidence.compact_statement: With 62% of workers in agriculture, Terai rainfed smallholders face floods; limited safety nets constrain coping.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Hazard selection and spatial mapping, printed pp. 25-27 (PDF p. 26).

evidence.compact_statement: Hazard maps place greatest river-flood risk along Nepal’s southern border and valleys, plus heat, drought, landslide, and air pollution.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Heat stress exposure, printed p. 30 (PDF p. 30).

evidence.scenario: Modeled 20-year heat-stress event; the passage is an exposure estimate, not a climate projection.
evidence.compact_statement: Over 4.3 million people fall in the extreme heat-stress category for a modeled 20-year event, concentrated in southern municipalities.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: CMIP6 precipitation projections, printed pp. 50-59 (PDF pp. 52-58).

evidence.compact_statement: Mid-century CMIP6 projections show larger extreme-precipitation changes in western Lumbini, Karnali, and Sudurpaschim than farther east.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Drought and temperature projections, printed pp. 50-59 (PDF pp. 52-58).

evidence.scenario: CMIP6 SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5, and SSP5-8.5; stronger warming is reported under SSP5-8.5.
evidence.compact_statement: The report projects persistent western drought and rising heat nationwide, with stronger warming under SSP5-8.5.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated not stated reports: UNDP says climate-related floods, landslides and agricultural shifts threaten human security in Barekot and Nalgad, where over 90% rely on agriculture; gender inequalities heighten women's food, health and economic insecurity.

pathways.compact_statement: The 2024 Nepal flood plan identifies protection risks where displacement meets service gaps and unequal access, without measuring new violence.
alternative_explanations: Pre-existing exclusion, accommodation design and service availability shape risk independently of hazard severity.
pathways.uncertainty: Historical needs assessment and prospective protection-risk mechanism, not a reported violence rate or climate-attribution estimate.
recommendations: Retain only evidence whose documented geography supports the pathway location; otherwise narrow the pathway or keep the evidence standalone.
